beats.title: Camp and Unanswered Questions
beats.boundaryReason: The session opens at camp; the party reviews Raven's Hold before choosing its next move.
dateEvidence: u0002–u0010 establish sunset and dinner preparations; session YAML anchors April 13.

beats.title: Choosing the Storm
beats.boundaryReason: The party turns from reviewing discoveries to choosing its route and discussing the storm, ley lines, and Vola.
dateEvidence: The camp conversation continues without a rest or departure.

beats.title: Vola Defends the Society
beats.boundaryReason: Dinner begins and Vola argues for cooperation, explains her priorities, and answers questions about Agata.
dateEvidence: u0419–u0428 begin dinner in the same evening camp.

beats.title: An Uneasy Agreement
beats.boundaryReason: The conversation becomes a concrete travel agreement; the party discusses artifact ownership, warnings, and how to carry its supplies.
dateEvidence: u0836 says it is getting late; u0864 proposes resting before an early start. Travel logistics continue before the enacted morning at u0943.

beats.title: Across the Burned Plains
beats.boundaryReason: A new day starts; the first travel day and evening camp form a complete travel beat. Its 115 lines are retained separately because the next beat begins the second morning.
dateEvidence: u0943 explicitly begins the morning after camp; u1012 covers midday and evening; u1030–u1042 concern that camp and the vulture report. u1033 is an interrupted next-day transition, completed at u1058.

beats.title: At the Storm's Edge
beats.boundaryReason: The second morning leads to arrival at the storm and the party's preparations, ending when it commits to entering.
dateEvidence: u1058 explicitly says next morning; u1112 describes late-afternoon arrival, refined at u1162 and u1250 to about two or three in the afternoon.

beats.title: Compelled by the Runes
beats.boundaryReason: The party enters the storm and encounters self-forming runes; the resulting attack and its resolution are contained here.
dateEvidence: Continuous travel from the afternoon arrival; no new rest or date change.

beats.title: Through the Wall of Wind
beats.boundaryReason: The storm intensifies into a wind-wall hazard, separates the party, and ends with everybody reunited in the calm eye.
dateEvidence: u1652–u1653 estimate one and a half to two hours inside the storm; u1738 explicitly places arrival in evening sunlight/late-afternoon sun.

beats.title: The Tower and the Grave
beats.boundaryReason: Reunited in the eye, the party investigates the tower exterior, campsite, grave, and ley-line node before Delwath enters.
dateEvidence: Continuous investigation after the late-afternoon arrival; no additional date transition.

beats.title: Delwath Scouts the Tower
beats.boundaryReason: Delwath turns invisible, investigates the damaged entry hall, and climbs through the living quarters toward the third floor.
dateEvidence: u2044 estimates 20–30 minutes of scouting; exact clock time is not stated.

beats.title: Escape from Living Lightning
beats.boundaryReason: Initiative marks a strong encounter boundary; the short fight, escape, and immediate account of the voice stay together despite the 90-line size.
dateEvidence: The escape immediately follows the scouting, before the sunset rest at u2433.

beats.title: Master Runes and Missing Stars
beats.boundaryReason: The party interprets the voice and lightning, discusses master runes, and rests until the missing constellations end the session.
dateEvidence: u2391 initiates a short rest; u2433 and u2447 explicitly describe sunset and emerging stars. No additional night passes.
